tracks.label: Beginner
tracks.description: Start here. Learn to talk to Python, store little facts, make choices, and repeat useful steps.

tracks.label: Intermediate
tracks.description: Build a bigger toolkit: little number machines, countdowns, tidy text, backpacks and treasure grids. Try Beginner first.

tracks.label: Advanced
tracks.description: Ready for a stretch? Build tiny factories, safety nets and pet blueprints. These lessons combine smaller ideas.

tracks.label: Algorithms
tracks.description: An algorithm is a recipe for solving a puzzle. Find a toy, sort marbles and plan a short route. Try Intermediate and Data Structures first.

tracks.label: Data Structures
tracks.description: Organize things with plate stacks, waiting lines, unique stickers, branching trees and friendship maps. Try Beginner first.

tracks.label: Ladder Logic
tracks.description: Drag contacts from the toolbox onto a rung. Connect the lamp coil, toggle virtual switches and watch your rule come to life.

tracks.label: Structured Text
tracks.description: Write Boolean rules for a pretend control panel. Toggle switches, run a scan and watch the lamp respond. No equipment needed.
